content: प्रवेणिः, -णी {%f.%} .²1 A braid of hair (in general); हेमभक्तिमतीं भूमेः प्रवेणीमिव पिप्रिये <ls>R. 15. 30</ls>. .²2 The hair twisted and unadorned (worn by wives in the absence of their husbands). .²3 The housings of an elephant. .²4 A piece of coloured woollen cloth; <ls>Mb. 15. 27. 13</ls>. .²5 The current or stream (of a river).
